# Karoot

> Karoot is Toronto's one stop for pet grooming: pet parents find trusted groomers, see transparent prices, and book in minutes — all in one app. Built by pet parents, for pet parents.

## What Karoot is

- A pet grooming marketplace for Toronto, Canada. Pet parents book grooming; groomers run their own profile, prices, and schedule.
- The Karoot app is available to download on the App Store and Google Play, and is rolling out across Toronto.
- Payments are handled securely through Stripe, including escrow for bookings.
- Groomers on Karoot include salon, in-home, and mobile groomers.

## Optional

- Founding groomers: Karoot's Founding 50 program recognizes early groomers on the platform with spotlights, community events, and featured placement. Founding 50 status is claimed after signing up in the app.
